title: A Critical History of English Literature Vol 1 From the Beginnings to Milton

vibeProfile.oneLine: Daiches's critical history of English literature, from the beginnings to Milton.

summary: The first volume of David Daiches's classic Critical History of English Literature runs from Anglo-Saxon beginnings through to Milton, surveying more than a thousand years of English writing in a single continuous narrative. Daiches combines historical breadth with sharp critical judgement, making it one of the most readable and widely used one-author histories of English literature. Authoritative yet personal, this volume covers the medieval, Tudor and early seventeenth-century periods with clarity and insight.
whyReadIt: Daiches's classic one-author history, from Anglo-Saxon beginnings to Milton. Readable, authoritative, opinionated.
